Local SQLite database, local file storage, in-app notifications
Document uploads up to 10 MB with an extension allowlist

RoleAssignment stores role start and end times. Profile exposes active Mentor and Learner assignments independently. Staff access uses Django Admin. Upload validator accepts .pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .txt, .docx and .doc up to 10 MiB. The interface labels this as 10 MB. No cloud object storage, payment processor or push notification service exists.

States in code: PENDING, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, REJECTED and CANCELLED. Requests block self-matching, require an active mentor role, and reject duplicate pending or active pairs. Rejected or cancelled requests refund the learner. Either participant or staff can access the workspace. Current completion view permits any authorised participant to mark an active mentorship completed and then forces progress to 100%.

name: 2 of 4 skills: 25 points   +   flexible: 27   +
text: 2 of 4 skills: 25 points   +   flexible: 27   +   one level ahead: 20

Deterministic matching, not a trained AI model. Total = round(skill_ratio*50 + availability_ratio*30 + experience_ratio*20), clamped 0 to 100. Availability ratios: exact non-empty match 1.0, either flexible 0.9, missing 0.6, incompatible 0.2. Experience gaps +1/+2 score 1.0, +3 scores 0.9, equal levels 0.65, mentor lower 0.25. Skills default to 0.5 if none selected. Tie-breaking uses mentor profile skill_score. Illustrative example is calculated from these rules, not an observed match.

Current active demo database stores 61.7%, not the 67% claimed in README and the older slide deck. Formula when both record types exist: 70*(completed milestones/total milestones)+30*(completed sessions/total sessions). When only one type exists it receives 100% weight. No records means 0%. Marking COMPLETED forces 100%, regardless of remaining checklist items. This is a workflow completion signal, not a verified competency assessment.

These are implemented rules in BadgeService, which supersede the original specification thresholds of 5 completed mentorships, skill score >80, 5 ratings and 5 resources. First Steps checks completed mentorships despite a badge description mentioning a milestone. Skill score is a stored profile value rather than an automatic mastery score. LeaderboardService iterates all active users, calculates the score and assigns consecutive ranks after sorting. No background job or push leaderboard exists.

Single Django project organised into five apps, not microservices. requirements.txt constrains Django >=5.0,<6.0. The local runtime test reports Django 5.2.17. Bootstrap version 5.3.3 appears in templates/base.html. Django auth User provides authentication, extended by Profile and RoleAssignment. Credit is a wallet model and is not an authentication model. Server-rendered HTTP requests execute synchronous business logic. No Celery, Redis, REST frontend or cloud dependency exists.

Proposed steps are recommendations, not implemented features or existing project commitments. Current DEBUG=True settings, a development secret and empty ALLOWED_HOSTS suit local demonstration only. Browser bootstrap assets come from public CDNs. Notifications use database records and request-time rendering, with no websocket or background reminder scheduler. Credit operations have duplicate checks but no transaction.atomic wrapper in current services. Certificate completion can be set by a participant before checklist completion. Real payments, native video integration, automated calendar sync and cloud hosting are outside the agreed local project scope.
